_instructions: Robinhood Chain Testnet has real faucet-issued Stock Tokens, but Chainlink price feeds for them exist on MAINNET ONLY (confirmed via the Arbitrum Foundation's Robinhood Chain dapp tutorial and its example repo, github.com/hummusonrails/robinhood-chain-dapp-example, which does the same thing). So the deploy script deploys its own MockAggregator (test/mocks/MockAggregator.sol, already used in our own test suite) per asset, seeded with `initialPriceUsd8` (8-decimal Chainlink convention, e.g. 42000000000 = $420.00), and registers AssetRegistry against that mock instead of a real feed. Prices below are illustrative placeholders, not live quotes — adjust freely, or call MockAggregator.setAnswer(...) later to move a price and test rebalancing behavior. `maxStaleness` is in seconds (86400 = 24h) — generous since these are mocks, not subject to the real off-hours-staleness question in DESIGN.md §8. Rows with a zero `token` address are skipped by the deploy script.
